Politics · India

PM Modi visits Australia, meets community and business leaders

Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Melbourne, Australia, as part of a three-country tour. He was welcomed by the Indian community and met with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese. During his visit, PM Modi participated in the India-Australia CEO Forum, emphasizing trade cooperation and inviting Australian participation in India's development. He also met with business leaders and highlighted opportunities in sectors like AI and technology, stating that bilateral trade has doubled. The visit included a stop at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, where he was accompanied by PM Albanese and took a photo with a statue of Don Bradman.
